name: Morocco

latest_census.notes: RGPH 2024 (Recensement Général de la Population et de l'Habitat), results published 17 Dec 2024. Language is asked two ways: 'langues locales utilisées' (Darija, Tachelhit, Tamazight, Tarifit, Hassania, other; multiple response -- 91.9% Darija, 24.8% Amazigh = 14.2% Tachelhit + 7.4% Tamazight + 3.2% Tarifit, 0.8% Hassania) and 'langue maternelle' (Arabic, Amazigh, French, English, Spanish, other), plus literacy in Tifinagh (1.5%). Religion and ethnicity: a search-result summary states 'the Moroccan census does not explicitly track ethnic or religious backgrounds' and that language is used as the proxy for Amazigh identity; the questionnaire itself was not seen, so 'not asked' is medium confidence. Amazigh associations (AMREC) contest the language figures as undercounts -- a caveat to carry on the record. Language shares are multiple-response ('uses'), so the 'langues locales' table is not a composition that sums to 100; 'langue maternelle' is the single-response field to prefer.

subnational_sources.title: Plateforme de diffusion du RGPH 2024 (interactive results platform, Apache Superset)
subnational_sources.matches_boundary_level: admin1 (12 regions vs 11 drawn) -- see notes
subnational_sources.evidence: HCP page 'Plateforme interactive du RGPH 2024' (https://www.hcp.ma/Plateforme-interactive-du-RGPH-2024_a4026.html) describes 'une base de données des indicateurs du RGPH 2024 sous forme de tableaux et graphiques' covering themes including 'langues locales utilisées'. The platform's own URLs surfaced in search: /superset/welcome/, /tablemodelview/list/ (Datasets), /dashboard/list/, /chart/list/, /explore/?slice_id=810 ('Population légale') -- i.e. an Apache Superset instance. Region-level language figures are quoted in press from HCP results (Souss-Massa: 63.2% use Tachelhit, 56.4% Tamazight mother tongue; Drâa-Tafilalet: 25.8% Tachelhit, 64% Tamazight native speakers), so at least the 12-region level exists. Superset charts normally export CSV, but that was not verified. Geography names are French with accents ('Fès-Meknès', 'Drâa-Tafilalet'); packet admin1 names are mixed ('Fez-Meknes'). Morocco has 12 regions; packet draws 11.

tier_reason: Language (mother tongue and local languages used) is a 2024 census count published subnationally, but it sits behind a Superset table-builder and regional PDFs rather than a plain CSV/XLSX, and the boundary file's 11 regions / 72 provinces do not exactly match Morocco's 12 regions / 75 provinces. Religion and ethnicity are not asked and belong in a not_collected declaration.
recommended_action: Open resultats2024.rgphapps.ma (Datasets list at /tablemodelview/list/) and look for the 'langue maternelle' and 'langues locales utilisées' datasets by région and by province; try the chart CSV export. Prefer 'langue maternelle' (single response) as the composition; if only multiple-response 'langues utilisées' is available, store it with an explicit non-summing basis. Map the 12 HCP regions onto the 11 drawn (find which region the boundary file merges or omits -- likely one of the Saharan regions) and normalise accented French names. Separately, the packet shows religion and ethnicity already filled for 6 of 11 admin1 from 'adapter:name'; since the census asks neither, the owner should review whether those should become not_collected declarations.

summary: Morocco's 2024 census (HCP) asked language -- mother tongue and local languages used -- but not religion or ethnicity, so those two fields should be declared not_collected (medium confidence: the statement comes from a search summary, not the questionnaire). Language results are published nationally as PDF and subnationally through an Apache Superset platform (resultats2024.rgphapps.ma) with region-level figures already quoted in press for Souss-Massa and Drâa-Tafilalet; provincial coverage is plausible but unconfirmed. Tier B: the count exists but is behind a table-builder, and the boundary file draws 11 regions and 72 provinces against Morocco's 12 and 75. The packet's existing religion/ethnicity fills for 6 regions conflict with the census not asking those questions and need owner review.
